abilities.name: thick-fat
abilities.effect: Halves damage from fire and ice moves.

abilities.name: sap-sipper
abilities.effect: Absorbs grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

original-johto.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

hoenn.flavorText: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water’s resistance.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.

updated-johto.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

original-unova.flavorText: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.

updated-unova.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

kalos.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon’s tail is flexible and configured to stretch.

swsh.flavorText: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.
